An article, not itself a rule.

```yaml
title: Fenced rule
logsource:
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image: 'C:\new\tool.exe'
  condition: selection
```

A second example:

    title: Indented rule
    logsource:
      product: linux
    detection:
      selection:
        Image: /bin/sh
      condition: selection

Unbounded prose below must never become a rule:
title: Fragment
logsource: {product: windows}
detection: {selection: {EventID: 1}, condition: selection}
